lines: Day eighteen. The mud froze overnight. In this bed lies a shepherd from Port Abel. His name is Karel Hier.
day
Two weeks ago he kept sheep on a hill. Then the army needed one more man.
sheep
On Day ten he took his place in the gap at V F eleven. Nobody told him what happened to the last man.
gap
On Day sixteen he came back from the hospital and became the chaplain of the line.
chap
That night, a raider dropped into the trench. Karel took a shovel to the head. He still brought back the enemy helmet.
raid
The wound turned bad. There were too few medics. This time, there was a bed.
bed

From the bed he bought War Bonds for the front, like Pavel Owl Hughesjack. The colonel poured him a real coffee. Then a shepherd dog came up the line with the ration party, and would not leave his side. He named her Sparky.
bonds
This morning a letter came. The fence is fixed. The cow is fine. The roof still leaks.
letter
Seventy-four Hegemony soldiers fell today. Fifty-nine from Concord. Almost all of them to rifles and machine guns.
fell
Only seven died waiting for care. Yesterday it was eighty-five. Both hospitals have thirty-eight beds now.
hosp
At the Bone Quarry, Hegemony leads, two hundred and twenty-six to one hundred and eighty-five. Three hundred wins the heights.
race
Forty-seven new soldiers came up the line. Two thousand three hundred and eighty-eight hold it now.
army
Pick a side. Comment HEGEMONY or CONCORD, and your soldier joins the war.
cta
